moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season gets underway this weekend, with reigning champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City on Friday night.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League is BACK this weekend. Who are you backing for the title this season? #PL

angles.name: Friday Night Football
angles.copy: Arsenal kick off the new Premier League season this Friday night at home to Coventry! Huge buzz around London. Where are you watching?

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Make Chart History
moments.blurb: Madonna's collaboration with Kylie Minogue, 'Love Sensation', has debuted at No. 8 on the Official Singles Chart and hit No. 1 on the Official Singles Sales chart, marking Madonna's first-ever No. 1 on that specific sales tally.

angles.name: Pop Queen Power
angles.copy: Two legends, one massive track! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is making waves on the charts, including a historic No. 1! What a moment for pop royalty.

angles.name: Chart Milestone
angles.copy: Did you hear? Madonna just scored her first ever No. 1 on the Official Singles Sales chart with her Kylie collab! Proof that the Queen of Pop still reigns supreme.

moments.title: Green Man Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Wales' beloved Green Man Festival kicks off tomorrow in the stunning Brecon Beacons National Park, bringing four days of independent music, arts, and good vibes.

angles.name: Wales Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Green Man Festival starts tomorrow! The Brecon Beacons are about to come alive with incredible music and arts. Who's heading to the fields? #GreenManFestival

angles.name: Indie Music Escape
angles.copy: Ready for some of the best indie and alternative acts in a stunning setting? Green Man Festival kicks off tomorrow! Soak up the atmosphere.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival starts tomorrow in Dorset, offering four days of jazz, UK club culture, soul, hip hop, and electronica, though tickets are now sold out.

source.l: We Out Here Festival Official Site

angles.name: Dance Festival Buzz
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is almost here! Kicking off tomorrow for four days of incredible jazz, club, soul & electronic music in Dorset. Even if sold out, the vibes will be huge!

angles.name: Festival of Discovery
angles.copy: Curated by Gilles Peterson, We Out Here Festival is a celebration of genre-hopping music. Get ready for the sounds to fill Dorset from tomorrow!

moments.title: Ariana Grande Continues O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' continues its highly anticipated ten-night residency at London's O2 Arena tonight, with more dates scheduled throughout August and into September.

angles.name: Ariana Live Tonight
angles.copy: The Eternal Sunshine Tour lights up The O2 again tonight! Are you one of the lucky ones seeing Ariana Grande live in London?

angles.name: Pop Spectacle
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is absolutely owning The O2 with her 'Eternal Sunshine' residency! If you're going, get ready for an unforgettable night.

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd continues his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' at Wembley Stadium tonight, part of his record-breaking stadium tour celebrating his acclaimed album trilogy.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: The Weeknd is bringing the 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to Wembley again tonight! Expect a spectacular show under the stars.

angles.name: Stadium Showstopper
angles.copy: Abel Tesfaye, aka The Weeknd, is delivering pure stadium magic at Wembley! Celebrating his iconic album trilogy, it's a show not to be missed.

moments.title: Happy 81st to Ian Gillan
moments.blurb: Legendary Deep Purple frontman Ian Gillan celebrates his 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the incredible voice of Deep Purple, Ian Gillan! What's your favourite Deep Purple track? #IanGillan #DeepPurple

angles.name: 70s Rocker
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Ian Gillan of Deep Purple, turning 81 today! A true icon of 70s rock.

moments.title: Happy 75th to John Deacon
moments.blurb: Queen bassist and songwriter John Deacon turns 75 today.

angles.name: Queen Bassist Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary John Deacon, the man behind some of Queen's biggest basslines and hits! #JohnDeacon #Queen

angles.name: Songwriting Genius
angles.copy: From 'Another One Bites the Dust' to 'I Want to Break Free,' John Deacon's songwriting for Queen is iconic. Happy 75th to him today!

moments.title: Happy 40th to Christina Perri
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Christina Perri, known for hits like 'Jar of Hearts' and 'A Thousand Years', celebrates her 40th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the amazing Christina Perri! Still love 'Jar of Hearts' and 'A Thousand Years'. What's your favourite track? #ChristinaPerri

angles.name: Love Song Queen
angles.copy: Sending birthday love to Christina Perri, turning 40 today! Her songs have soundtracked so many special moments.

moments.title: Amplitude Festival Swansea
moments.blurb: The free Amplitude festival hits Swansea Amphitheatre this weekend (Aug 22-23), celebrating the area's thriving grassroots music scene with a mix of genres from indie to jazz.

angles.name: Swansea Music Fest
angles.copy: Amplitude Festival is bringing free live music to Swansea Amphitheatre this weekend! Get ready for two days celebrating local talent. #Swansea #AmplitudeFestival

angles.name: Grassroots Vibes
angles.copy: If you're in Swansea this weekend, check out the Amplitude Festival! Free entry and a fantastic showcase of grassroots music.

moments.title: Big Food Festival Aberystwyth
moments.blurb: Wales' biggest street food festival rolls into Aberystwyth this weekend (Aug 21-23) for three days of culinary delights with free entry.

angles.name: Aberystwyth Foodie Fun
angles.copy: Calling all foodies! The Big Food Festival is in Aberystwyth this weekend (Aug 21-23). Get ready for three days of delicious street food and free entry! #Aberystwyth #FoodFestival

angles.name: Taste of Wales
angles.copy: The biggest street food festival in Wales arrives in Aberystwyth tomorrow! Who's excited to sample some incredible dishes?

moments.title: Happy 72nd to Elvis Costello
moments.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Elvis Costello celebrates his 72nd birthday on August 25.

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 72nd Birthday to the one and only Elvis Costello on August 25! A true songwriting genius. #ElvisCostello #Birthday

angles.name: Classic Hits Legend
angles.copy: From 'Alison' to 'Pump It Up', Elvis Costello's catalogue is timeless. Happy 72nd to him this Sunday!

moments.title: Happy 61st to Shania Twain
moments.blurb: Global superstar Shania Twain, Queen of Country Pop, turns 61 on August 29.

angles.name: Country Pop Queen
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Happy 61st Birthday to the incredible Shania Twain on August 29! Still rocking it. #ShaniaTwain #Birthday

angles.name: 90s Icon
angles.copy: 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' and so many more hits. Wishing Shania Twain a fantastic 61st birthday this Saturday!

moments.title: Guildhall Live Festival Exeter
moments.blurb: Exeter's Guildhall Shopping Centre celebrates its 50th birthday with a free three-day 'Guildhall Live' music festival from August 29-31, featuring tribute acts and local talent.

angles.name: Exeter's Free Festival
angles.copy: Exeter! Get ready for Guildhall Live, a FREE three-day music festival in Market Square this Bank Holiday weekend (Aug 29-31) with amazing tribute acts and local performers! #Exeter #GuildhallLive

angles.name: Decades of Music
angles.copy: Celebrating 50 years of music! Exeter's Guildhall Live festival features tribute acts covering hits from the 70s to today, starting August 29.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just around the corner on Monday, August 31, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Prep
angles.copy: That long weekend feeling is almost here! The August Bank Holiday is Monday 31st. What are your plans for the last hurrah of summer? #BankHoliday

angles.name: End of Summer Vibes
angles.copy: Monday 31st August = Summer Bank Holiday! Time to make the most of those extra hours of freedom. What's on your agenda?
